fields.name: ClusterClientDbOptions library configuration record
fields.contract: ClusterClientDbOptions exposes a mutable configuration record for a cluster client. Its public contract carries: a required DatabaseKey initialized to "Common"; an optional ConnectionString initialized to null; a required GatewayListQuery initialized to QueryProcedure("rdr.OrleansClusterGatewayListV1", ["@ClusterId"]); and a MaxRefreshInterval initialized to 60 seconds. The declaration alone does not establish how any consumer resolves these values.
